name: clear_word_field_after_call

name: halve_word_with_conditional_xor

name: xor_low_word_arguments

name: dispatch_when_mask_flags_set

name: stub_empty_return

name: run_setup_then_conditional_call

name: test_bitmap_cell_flag

name: test_bitmap_bit_bounded

name: test_bitmap_bit_unchecked
description: Returns the selected bit of a bitmap byte, indexed by a row and column pair in a table with rows 316 bytes apart, with no range checks.

name: return_constant_hundred

name: unlink_node_or_mark_pending

name: set_flag_bit_return_zero

name: copy_two_longs_to_globals

name: load_and_validate_icon_record
description: Builds a path with the .info extension, loads an icon record from it, and checks the record's magic word and version. It allocates the image and option buffers the record needs and returns on success or zero on failure.

name: validate_icon_record_fields
description: Checks an icon record's magic word and version, then allocates and fills its image and option buffers. It releases the buffers through a library call when a step fails and returns one on success or zero otherwise.

name: fill_icon_pointer_arrays

name: fill_pointer_array_entries

name: stub_empty_return

name: write_icon_record_to_file
description: Writes an icon record to a file in icon format using a 260-byte path buffer, writing the header fields and then the image and pointer-array sections. It releases the buffer and the file on exit and returns one on success or zero on failure.

name: write_icon_record_sections
description: Writes the image and option sections of an icon record, using a library call for each write, and restores a saved field before returning. It returns one on success and zero when any write fails.

name: write_icon_pointer_arrays
description: Writes three optional sections of an icon record: a single block at offset 50, a null-terminated list of blocks at offset 54 and a single block at offset 70, each preceded by a length value. It returns one when all writes succeed and zero otherwise.

name: write_pointer_list_items

name: write_pointer_table_entries

name: walk_list_nodes_until_end

name: walk_linked_nodes_to_tail

name: call_routine_at_offset_140

name: allocate_init_168_byte_record

name: store_pair_in_counter_slot

name: allocate_init_94_byte_record

name: call_routine_at_offset_78

name: find_value_in_string_list

name: scan_list_for_equals_sign

name: scan_list_for_equals_sign

name: scan_chain_for_length_match

name: allocate_record_and_register

name: copy_string_bounded_pad

name: check_record_then_apply_field
description: Returns one for a null record. For a non-null record it calls a routine with the size 20, and if that succeeds it makes two more calls and passes the value at offset 10 to a third routine, returning that result or zero.

name: walk_record_list_applying_routines
description: Walks a linked list of records through the link at offset 12, calling one routine on each record and a second routine on the pointer at offset 8, sized by four times the byte at offset 7. It returns one when every record succeeds and zero on the first failure.

name: walk_record_list_until_end
description: Repeats two routine calls on each record reached through the link at offset 12, returning one when the list ends or zero as soon as either call fails.

name: return_zero_stub

name: allocate_record_with_buffer

name: return_minus_one_stub

name: build_linked_record_list

name: build_linked_record_list
description: Builds a linked list of 16-byte records, one for each requested entry, each with a buffer pointer at offset 8 sized from the byte at offset 7 and linked through offset 12. It returns the first record on success and minus one on failure.

name: build_linked_record_list

name: allocate_and_store_handle

name: close_library_and_free_memory

name: unload_font_entries_or_mark
description: Walks a list of font entries, unlinking and freeing those with no remaining users. When no entries remain and the flag word is zero it unloads the segment, frees the structure and returns the handle; otherwise it marks the structure and returns zero.

name: release_font_structure_or_mark
description: If the structure's flag word is zero and its use count is not positive, it closes the libraries, unlinks the structure and returns its handle. Otherwise it sets bit 128 of the flag byte and returns zero.

name: mark_structure_pending_release
description: Sets bit 128 of the flag byte at offset 14 of the structure and returns zero.

name: stub_empty_return

name: clear_flag_bit_and_count

name: decrement_counter_call_on_zero
description: Library code that decrements the 16-bit counter at offset 38 and, when it reaches zero while bit 128 of the flag byte at offset 14 is set, calls a routine through a library vector and returns its result; otherwise it returns zero.

name: collect_font_entries_into_buffer
description: Fills a buffer with entries for named font records, first from an internal list of names and then, when flag bit 2 is set, from matching font files on disk. Each entry stores its name, size and style, and the routine returns the amount by which the buffer overflowed, or zero when everything fitted.

name: collect_font_entries_from_list
description: Walks a linked list of named font records, storing each name with its size, style and flags in a buffer. When flag bit 2 is set it also scans font files for matching entries, and it returns the overflow amount or zero.

name: collect_font_entries_from_text
description: Parses a text list of font names, storing each name in a buffer with its size and style, and when flag bit 2 is set it also scans font files. It returns the overflow amount, or zero when all entries fitted.

name: collect_fonts_dir_entries
description: Copies name characters into a buffer and stores an entry at each name boundary, scanning the FONTS directory when flag bit 2 is set. It returns the overflow amount, or zero when all entries fitted.

name: scan_font_directory_entries
description: Walks a list of font entries and, for each one whose name ends with the font file extension, reads matching font files and adds entries to a buffer. It returns the overflow amount, or zero when everything fitted.

name: scan_font_directory_entries
description: Copies name characters into a buffer and scans matching font files, adding an entry for each. It returns the overflow amount, or zero when everything fitted.

name: read_font_file_entries
description: Copies characters of a name into a buffer, reads matching font files and adds an entry for each one, returning the overflow amount or zero when everything fitted.

name: read_font_file_entries
description: Copies characters of a name into a buffer, reads matching font files and adds an entry for each one, closing the directory lock before returning the overflow amount or zero.

name: return_zero_stub

name: score_font_entry_match
description: Scores how closely a font entry matches a requested size and style. It starts from a value derived from the size difference and subtracts a weight for each of seven mismatched style bits, or returns a very low value when the entry has no size.

name: score_font_entry_match
description: Scores a font entry against a request: it starts from a base value derived from the size difference and subtracts a weight for each of seven mismatched style bits.

name: subtract_style_mismatch_weights
description: Subtracts a weight for each mismatched style bit across seven bit positions from a running score and returns the result.

name: subtract_style_mismatch_weights
description: Subtracts a weight for each mismatched style bit across seven bit positions from a running score, stopping once all seven positions have been checked, and returns the result.

name: return_constant_value

name: select_best_matching_font

name: select_font_from_fonts_dir

name: select_font_from_fonts_dir

name: select_highest_scoring_entries

name: select_highest_scoring_entries

name: select_highest_scoring_entries

name: release_selected_font_entries
description: Selects the highest-scoring record from a table of 260-byte entries and releases each chosen record through library calls, linking qualifying records into a list. It returns the last linked pointer.

name: load_font_file_entries
description: Reads the entries of a font file into a newly allocated table of 260-byte records. It returns the table, or null when the file cannot be read, and releases its temporary buffers and locks before returning.

name: load_disk_font_table

name: handle_keyboard_status_byte
description: Checks a keyboard status byte: when bit 3 is set it writes 255 to a byte if the status byte equals the letter v, then loops indefinitely. Otherwise it stores eight in the structure field at offset 156.

name: build_glyph_table_entries
description: Reads characters from a text string and, for each one, copies seven rows of glyph data from a font table into a buffer spaced 40 bytes apart. Once the terminator is reached it stores the final byte times 50 in a header field and clears a neighbouring word.

name: initialize_buffer_descriptor
description: Stores a pointer to a global buffer at the start of a structure, followed by three 16-bit values: 3464, 1480 and 64.

name: advance_timed_display_effect
description: Advances a timed display effect: it updates a counter and a small table of six words, runs a routine repeatedly, and waits on a busy flag before writing addresses and sizes into hardware registers.

name: advance_timed_display_effect
description: Runs the same timed display step without the table reset: it updates a timer, adjusts a row of words, and programs hardware addresses after the busy flag clears.

name: advance_timed_display_effect
description: Starts the timed display state and, once the busy flag clears, programs hardware addresses and sizes. It runs an update routine three times when the counter passes its threshold.

name: xor_circle_bitmap_rows
description: Draws the outline of a circle into a bitmap row by row: for each row it looks up a precomputed value from squared distances and XORs one bit in each of two bitmap buffers, mirroring the row's bit on the other side.

name: xor_circle_bitmap_rows
description: Continues the circle outline across the remaining rows, XORing one bit in each of two bitmap buffers per row, until the row index passes its limit.

name: xor_circle_bitmap_rows
description: Completes the circle outline by XORing bit pairs into two bitmap buffers for each remaining row, with the row values taken from a lookup table of squared distances.

name: clear_matching_patch_signature
description: Program entry for the Installer: it calls setup routines, frees memory through the library base three times, and then checks a structure field. When a patch signature matches, it saves the original word and clears it.

name: decrement_until_minus_one
description: Decrements a 16-bit local counter until it reaches minus one, then returns.

description: Invokes a function pointer stored in a global variable, then measures the null-terminated text in a 140-byte stack buffer and passes the buffer and its length to another routine when the length is nonzero.
